sloka: गर्गश्च च्यवनश्चैव शतानन्दश्च धर्मवित् ।भरद्वाजश्च तेजस्वी ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च सुप्रभः ।। ७.९६.४ ॥
transliteration: gargaśca cyavanaścaiva śatānandaśca dharmavit ।bharadvājaśca tejasvī hyagniputraśca suprabhaḥ ।। 7.96.4 ॥

translations.english: Garga, Chyavana, Shatananda the knower of dharma, the radiant Bharadvaja, and the brilliant Agniputra were also among them.
